title: Do LLM Evaluators Prefer Themselves for a Reason?

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting pairwise LLM-as-a-judge evaluations on verifiable benchmarks (MATH500, MMLU, MBPP+) with objective ground truths to calculate the Self-Preference Ratio (SPR), Legitimate Self-Preference Ratio (LSPR), and Harmful Self-Preference Propensity (HSPP).

Comparing the self-preference ratio on instances where models have different correctness outcomes versus instances where both models are equally correct or incorrect, in order to decouple preference driven by style or formatting from objective correctness.
